final: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 0) AS percentage_women FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.A11 > 10000
